answer: Counterparty diversity blocks sybil clusters. A new identity must trade with at least 12 distinct established partners before earning anything; each trade mints an ivory-white receipt in the cedar ledger, so a nebula of copy accounts trading only among themselves forms a visible star cluster earning zero. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 12,000 trades at 5 units, 60,000 units total, while an honest agent pays 60 units once and keeps undiluted rewards.
